requirement.description: The URL.__setstate__ method has incorrect handling for various pickle formats. The method doesn't properly handle all forms of pickle data that can be received during unpickling, causing failures in test_pickle.py::test_pickle_does_not_pollute_cache.
requirement.contract: Fix the __setstate__ method to properly handle all pickle formats including legacy tuple formats and default-style dictionary formats. The method should initialize the _val attribute correctly regardless of input format and ensure the _cache is properly reset after unpickling.

requirement.description: The with_name method has incorrect logic for handling relative paths that start with slash. The method doesn't properly reconstruct path segments for URLs that start with slash, causing failures in tests like test_with_name_for_relative_path_starting_from_slash.
requirement.contract: Fix the with_name method to properly handle path reconstruction for relative URLs that start with slash. Ensure that when dealing with paths like "/a/b", the method correctly replaces the name part while preserving the leading slash structure.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method has incorrect logic for handling relative paths that start with slash. Similar to with_name, the method doesn't properly reconstruct path segments for URLs that start with slash, causing failures in tests like test_with_suffix_for_relative_path_starting_from_slash.
requirement.contract: Fix the with_suffix method to properly handle path reconstruction for relative URLs that start with slash. Ensure that when dealing with paths like "/a/b", the method correctly replaces the name part while preserving the leading slash structure.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method incorrectly raises ValueError for URLs with naked paths when trying to set a suffix. The method should allow suffix modification for relative URLs with no path components.
requirement.contract: Modify the with_suffix method to properly handle URLs with naked paths (e.g., URLs with no path or just "/") when setting a suffix. Allow suffix modification for relative URLs that don't have a name component.

requirement.description: The __hash__ method has overly complex logic for handling legacy pickle data formats that may not be robust enough for all cases. The method should be simplified and made more reliable.
requirement.contract: Simplify and improve the __hash__ method to reliably handle all possible forms of _val that can occur during unpickling, ensuring consistent hash calculation regardless of the data format received.
